title: DNA Barcoding in Field Setting
author: Aaron Pomerantz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y2sfyee
materials: GoTaq G2 Hot Start master mix

Equipment BlueGel system MiniOne system Create .8 - 1.0% agarose 1 gel with 13 combs Measure 1 g of agarose Mix agraose with 100 mL of 1xTBE Microwave the mixture until agarose is completely dissolved (1-3 min) Pour the agarose gel into the tray with the comb in place. Allow the agarose gel to harden (20-30 min) Insert the agarose gel into electrophoresis equipment and add 1xTBE buffer until the agarose gel is submerged Spot check with 2 µL of each sample Mix 1 µL of loading dye to 2 µL of each sample and load the gel. (If Green Taq buffer with built in loading dye was used, skip this step). Load 5 µL of 100bp ladder into the agarose gel. Turn on the electrode and let the DNA run until the band is identifiable

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mixes
steps.instruction: Assemble the appropriate master mix for each target group using the listed reagents, volumes, and catalog numbers.

substeps.instruction: Butterfly rDNA (25 µL total): 1.25 µL forward primer, 1.25 µL reverse primer, 9.5 µL water, 3 µL template DNA, 10 µL Q5 High‑Fidelity 2X Master Mix (NEB Cat #M0492L).
Mammal rDNA (13.5 µL total): 1.00 µL forward primer, 1.00 µL reverse primer, 2.0 µL water, 3 µL template DNA, 6.5 µL Q5 Master Mix.
Plant rDNA (13.5 µL total): 1.00 µL forward primer, 1.00 µL reverse primer, 2.0 µL water, 3 µL template DNA, 6.5 µL Q5 Master Mix.
Butterfly COI (25 µL total): 1.25 µL forward primer, 1.25 µL reverse primer, 7 µL water, 3 µL template DNA, 12.5 µL Q5 Master Mix.
Plant rBCL & matK (25 µL total): 1.25 µL forward primer, 1.25 µL reverse primer, 7 µL water, 3 µL template DNA, 12.5 µL Q5 Master Mix.

Ectoparasites/eDNA/dung beetles/snails COI (12.5 µL total): 2.5 µL Taq buffer, 1.25 µL MgCl₂, 0.0625 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 0.125 µL forward primer, 0.125 µL reverse primer, 6.3775 µL water, 2 µL template DNA, 0.06 µL Hot‑Start GoTaq (Promega Cat #M7402).

Dung beetles/ectoparasites/butterflies COI (12.5 µL total): 2.5 µL Taq buffer, 2 µL MgCl₂, 0.0625 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 0.125 µL forward primer, 0.125 µL reverse primer, 5.63 µL water, 2 µL template DNA, 0.06 µL Hot‑Start GoTaq.

steps.title: Run rDNA PCR
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the rDNA cycling profile and run the reactions prepared above.

steps.title: Run COI PCR
steps.instruction: Program and execute the two sequential COI programs as described.

substeps.instruction: First COI program: Initial denaturation 2 min at 94 °C; denaturation 30 s at 94 °C; annealing 40 s at 50 °C; extension 1 min at 72 °C; 5 cycles; final extension 1 min at 94 °C.
Second COI program: Initial denaturation 1 s at 94 °C; denaturation 30 s at 94 °C; annealing 40 s at 52 °C; extension 1 min at 72 °C; 35 cycles; final extension 10 min at 72 °C.

steps.title: Pool amplicons without quantification
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of each PCR amplicon directly into the library pool (no fluorometer check).

steps.title: Perform barcoding PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL barcoding PCR using 1 µL each barcode primer, 2 µL of each positive amplicon, and a master mix similar to the earlier Q5 mixes; run the following thermocycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Extension 40 s at 72 °C (extend to 85 s for ~1000 bp amplicons).

steps.title: SPRI bead cleanup of library
steps.instruction: Purify the pooled library with a 1:1 SPRI bead ratio, resuspend the eluate in the same volume of buffer, using Agencourt Ampure XP (Beckman Coulter Cat #A63880).
